observations: Orange and black portable generator on a metal stand with red wheels.
Brand 'KEMAGE' is clearly visible on the front panel and top cover.
Control panel includes an AC 230V outlet, a 12V DC port, and a voltmeter.
A red warning label is visible on the right side of the control panel.
The generator is shown in a retail or showroom environment with other boxes in the background.

claims.evidence: The model plate is not visible in the photo to confirm the power rating.

risks.risk: The engine may be non-functional or have internal mechanical issues.
risks.proof: A video showing the engine starting and running.

risks.risk: The alternator may be faulty, leading to unstable or zero voltage output.
risks.proof: A video showing a multimeter reading the output voltage while the unit is running.

risks.risk: The fuel tank or carburetor may be clogged or leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing the generator running on fresh fuel.
risks.if_unproven: as needing a rebuild or overhaul

risks.risk: Essential accessories like the fuel tank, oil filter, or spark plug may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included parts laid out.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the generator running and producing power.
Photo of the technical specification plate (usually on the side or back) to confirm the 8.5kVA rating.
Photo of the included accessories (fuel tank, oil filter, spark plug).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
